notes.title: Major Update Sale
notes.content: Considering all the feedback recieved in this first year of our game we consider that a change in the overall aesthetics of the game. Along with some bug fixes and minor changes in the content, we are glad to anounce this basically new version of the game. You can expect more changes in the future, giving the fact that we are currently working on some other improvements that we hope to release soon. So with that said we really hope that you can have fun.

notes.title: Achievements are live!
notes.content:
[h1]New content[/h1]

We are now releasing a set of 18 achievements for you to master.



[h1]Acknowledgements[/h1]

We also would like to thank VulpixFX for his comment on our game and for his invaluable contructive criticism, which gave us some amazing ideas and reassured ourselves that we are in the right path. We are working to make this game the best version of itself.

Expect to hear from us soon,
Three Stone Kings
